raw_segments.text: Yes, Pip, dear boy, I've made a gentleman on you. It's me Watt has done it. I swore
that time, sure as ever I earned a guinea, that guinea should go to you. I swore ardourwards,
sure as ever I speculated and got rich, you should get rich. I lived rough that you should
live smooth, I worked hard that you should be above work. What odds, dear boy, do I tell
it for you to feel a obligation? Not a bit.
I tell it for you to know is that their hunted, dung-hill dog Watt you kept life in, got his
head so high that he could make a gentleman. And Pip, you're him.
